title: Abyssals v0.90.50 — Playtest Polish
notes: Redesigned double battles with the single-battle HUD, partner portrait, move-first foe targeting; five distinct Sporefall chasm environment backgrounds and two new side paths; Fortified Ration with fixed 21x generic capture strength, first sold in Botrune; new Cayfen and Ramelle NPC errands; automatic post-Hierophant descent and Hell Mirror portal introducing canonical Severin Vale, for either spared/executed fates. Existing saves, legendary capture tiers and original APK signing are preserved. Full bespoke move artwork expansion remains a separate substantial production phase.
